scope: 52 exact owner-region crop/context reviews. Highlights, source-value and class-eligibility grades remain separate; no sentinel exception is granted.

sourceReview.status: source-geometry-reviewed; no catalog or ledger edits

sourceIdentity.storage: private; original source PDF is not part of public deliverables

sharedUseInventory.status: candidate and applicability inventory; semantic dispositions remain item-scoped

sourceReview.reviewMethod: Compared each full original PDF page rendered from the private source PDF to the exact 144-DPI candidate PNGs and their frozen point/normalized bounds. Also inspected full original PHB pp.27, 32, 33 and corresponding existing Assassin crops. Exact candidate bytes matched receipt hashes.

proposedRecipeReviews.finding: Complete four-star scroll-reading line; Assassin level-12 clause visible. Keep existing class-limit table image separately.
Complete table title, headings, all levels 1–17, and all race rows through Half-Orc. Crop stops after the table; explanatory notes below are outside this table-scoped region.
Complete left-column two-class section, both listed benefits, and full worked-example opening through “however, the”.
Same printed PHB p.33 / PDF p.34; completes that example beginning “character gets…” and stops before ALIGNMENT.
Complete Added Proficiency paragraph, including above-first-level rule and level 1/5/9/13 example.

previousTrimReviews.finding: Crop ends after the complete thief secondary-functions/backstab passage; the removed next-section heading is unrelated. It remains generic thief-baseline evidence, not proof of UA-specific application.

Crop includes the complete multi-class introduction and the Cleric combinations through Cleric/Assassin, and ends before the separate Fighter/Magic-user paragraph. It is general combination background only and does not establish eligibility for any other class pair.

sharedConsumerDispositions.disposition: The new footnote is relevant to Assassin /levelChanges/35 per the frozen map. Same-page class hit-dice/limit citations are not footnote uses; do not attach scroll-reading claim to them.

Complete table image is generic thief-function table context. Exact old-hash uses in thief, monk, UA Barbarian and UA Thief-Acrobat remain per-item; crop completeness does not verify their class-specific derivations.
UA Thief-Acrobat is the other exact old-image consumer. The crop is generic thief-function baseline only; UA-specific application remains pending.

Nine other core class catalogs use the old shared image. The inspected trim preserves a complete general multi-class introduction and cleric examples through Cleric/Assassin, but does not prove any other class pairing eligible.

Other core-class cards and dual-class/progression records use same/nearby general procedure crops. The example may be shown as general switching context; it does not prove Assassin or any class-specific eligibility. The new two-segment continuation is present only in the Assassin recipe; other catalogs retain their own per-item unresolved/pending state.

The added-proficiency note is directly relevant to 49 core-class progression properties. The frozen application adds it only to the Assassin catalog; note-context remains unprovided for the other 48 fields unless the crop is added to their exact owner catalogs. Four UA Thief-Acrobat PHB p.37 rows remain uncertain because their stated derivation is UA p.25. Equipment p.37 damage/weight fields are unrelated.

sourceReview.decision: Approve exact source geometry/content for the five frozen candidate images and the p27/p32 Assassin trims, within the listed scopes. This is not value, mechanics, eligibility, highlight, or source-completeness approval. Keep p37 non-Assassin context explicitly pending unless each owner catalog receives the note crop; shared region matches do not inherit review.
